description:
A machine learning researcher needs to link the official code implementations to their corresponding papers in the Zotero library. Your task is to find three specific papers and attach their GitHub repository URLs using the 'Attach Link to URI' feature.

Target Papers and URLs:
1. 'Attention Is All You Need' -> https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor
2. 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding' -> https://github.com/google-research/bert
3. 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' -> https://github.com/KaimingHe/deep-residual-networks

Instructions:
1. Locate each paper in the library.
2. Add an attachment by selecting 'Attach Link to URI...' (via the paperclip icon or right-click menu).
3. Paste the exact URL provided above.
4. Ensure the link is attached to the correct paper.

targets.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
